purpose.summary: This is a file handler (FH) module for the ACAS (Applewood Computers Accounting System) Purchase Ledger subsystem, specifically managing I/O for the 'Delfolio' (Delivery Invoice Numbers) file/table. It supports both COBOL flat-file (ISAM) access and RDBMS (via a DAL module) for read, write, rewrite, delete, start, and open/close operations.

notable_features: EXEC SQL (embedded SQL for RDBMS DAL integration)
Dual-mode processing: COBOL flat files and RDBMS
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple copybook-defined records
Extensive inline documentation and change history
GNU GPL licensed open-source accounting system
No COMP-3 usage despite accounting domain
